verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of SSH host management, saved connections, or credential storage — only directory bookmarks and window/config features are documented. Since a-Shell is a terminal app where SSH host connectivity is a reasonable axis, but no evidence shows a saved-host one-tap login feature, this is 'none'. Missing for 10: any SSH client documentation, saved-host/bookmark-for-SSH feature, credential/key storage, one-tap reconnect evidence.
